description: This PHP class defines data transfer object (DTO) parameters for filtering searches related to internationalization language entries within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, adding specific filter options such as 'enabled only' and 'added only', and specifying allowed sort fields.

classes.name: I18NLanguageSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filtering parameters specific to searching for Internationalization (i18n) languages, allowing filtering by enabled status and addition status, with a default sort on language name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with the default sort field set to language name ('l.name').

methods.name: getEnabledOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to only include enabled languages.

methods.name: setEnabledOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only enabled languages if true, or all if false or null.

methods.name: getAddedOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is set to only include languages that have been added.

methods.name: setAddedOnly
methods.description: Sets the filter to include only languages that have been added if true, or all if false or null.
